name: News
looksLike: a site with headlines and recent reporting
a newspaper website with sections and breaking stories
a homepage full of current news articles
definition: A publication website that helps readers find current reporting, understand when it was published or updated, and distinguish news from opinion or advertising.
goal: Help readers discover timely reporting and understand its context.
audience: Readers following current events or a specialist beat

sections.name: Headlines and sections
sections.purpose: Prioritize important stories and show clear topic navigation.

sections.name: Story lists
sections.purpose: Group reporting by topic and recency.

sections.name: Article and context
sections.purpose: Show attribution, dates, sources, and corrections.

sections.name: More reporting
sections.purpose: Offer related coverage and publication information.

mustHave: Labels for opinion and sponsored material

prompts.short: Build a news site with topic sections, current headlines, readable reporting, and clear attribution.
prompts.detailed: Build a news website for readers following current events or a specialist beat. Help readers discover timely reporting and understand its context. Include headlines and sections, story lists, article and context, more reporting. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Publication and update timestamps.
